english.name: On the First Day I Built an Army.
english.description: On the first day you recruited eight archers.

schinese.name: 第一天，我组建了军队。
schinese.description: 第一天，你招募了八名弓箭手。

english.name: On the Second Day I Got a Gift.
english.description: On the second day you got free walls.

schinese.name: 第二天，我收到了礼物。
schinese.description: 第二天，你免费获得了城墙。

english.name: On the Third Day I Lit a Fire.
english.description: On the third day you started your camp.

schinese.name: 第三天，我点燃了篝火。
schinese.description: 第三天，你建立了营地。

english.name: On the Fourth Day We Had a Feast.
english.description: By the fourth day you hunted 20 or more deer.

schinese.name: 第四天，我们大摆宴席。
schinese.description: 到第四天，你猎到了 20 只以上的鹿。

english.name: For Five Days I Turned the Other Cheek.
english.description: For five days you didn't kill anything.

schinese.name: 整整五天，我打不还手。
schinese.description: 连续五天，你没有杀死任何生物。

english.name: By the Sixth Day I Was Rich.
english.description: By the sixth day you had more gold than you could carry.

schinese.name: 到第六天，我富甲一方。
schinese.description: 到第六天，你的金币多到拿不下。

english.name: By the Seventh Day I Cleared an Acre.
english.description: By the seventh day you cleared an acre of land.

schinese.name: 到第七天，我开垦了一英亩。
schinese.description: 到第七天，你清理出了一英亩土地。

english.name: On the Eighth Day I Fumbled.
english.description: Until the eighth day you never dropped a coin on the ground.

schinese.name: 第八天，我手滑了。
schinese.description: 直到第八天，你从未把硬币掉在地上。

english.name: On the Ninth Day I First Ran.
english.description: Until the ninth day you never galloped.

schinese.name: 第九天，我第一次策马奔驰。
schinese.description: 直到第九天，你从未让坐骑疾驰过。

english.name: On The Tenth Day We Fought Back!
english.description: By the tenth day you destroyed a portal.

schinese.name: 第十天，我们奋起反击！
schinese.description: 到第十天，你摧毁了一座传送门。

english.name: Maiden Voyage
english.description: Build the boat and escape the first land before day 10.

schinese.name: 处女航
schinese.description: 在第 10 天之前造好船，逃离第一片大陆。

english.name: Smooth Sailing
english.description: Build the boat and escape the second land before day 15.

schinese.name: 一帆风顺
schinese.description: 在第 15 天之前造好船，逃离第二片大陆。

english.name: Stormy Waters
english.description: Build the boat and escape the third land before day 20.

schinese.name: 惊涛骇浪
schinese.description: 在第 20 天之前造好船，逃离第三片大陆。

english.name: Reef the Main

schinese.name: 缩帆迎风
schinese.description: 在第 25 天之前造好船，逃离第四片大陆。

english.name: All Hands on Deck
english.description: Build the boat and escape the fifth land before day 30.

schinese.name: 全员上甲板
schinese.description: 在第 30 天之前造好船，逃离第五片大陆。

english.name: Birth of a Reign
english.description: Win your first game.

schinese.name: 王朝初立
schinese.description: 赢得你的第一局游戏。

english.name: Interior Decoration
english.description: Earn some antlers to decorate your coat of arms.

schinese.name: 装点门面
schinese.description: 赢得鹿角，用来装饰你的纹章。

english.name: Heraldic Achievement
english.description: Have a reign that spans five lands.

schinese.name: 纹章成就
schinese.description: 让你的统治横跨五片大陆。

english.name: Crowned
english.description: Escape the final land and earn the crown.

schinese.name: 加冕
schinese.description: 逃离最后一片大陆，赢得王冠。
